notes.title: Official Release announcement
notes.notes:
Hello guys, am Henry from kc games. We are sorry for leaving it late to announce our official release. We are trying to fix some issues, of which our social media presence and website is actually one of them. Everything will be settled by next week.

You can post videos and screenshots of your progress for others to see. We will be adding more contents like weapons, armors, skills, levels e.t.c in future. Should in case you notice any bug, please let us know, for immediate fix. Have a wonderful day.

Lets i forget, new suggestions and ideas are welcomed.
